arguments.sql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_usd DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Totals each user's transaction amounts across all their cards and lists the five highest, largest first.
assumptions: Spending is the sum of all transaction amounts as recorded, including the negative amounts (their meaning is undocumented, so they are not removed or treated as refunds).
Transactions are linked to users through cards (transactions.card_id -> cards.user_id), and all transactions are included whether or not they have a fraud label.
Ties in total are broken by user id, ascending.
Dates covered are the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
